queries.sql: SELECT date, client, page, root_page, wptid, technologies FROM `httparchive.crawl.pages` WHERE date IN ('2020-01-01','2020-02-01','2020-03-01','2020-04-01') AND client = 'desktop' AND is_root_page QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY date ORDER BY SHA256(root_page), wptid) <= 20

SELECT date, client, page, root_page, wptid, technologies FROM `httparchive.crawl.pages` WHERE date IN ('2023-04-01','2023-05-01') AND client = 'desktop' AND is_root_page QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY date ORDER BY SHA256(root_page), wptid) <= 20

SELECT date, client, page, root_page, wptid, technologies FROM `httparchive.crawl.pages` WHERE date IN ('2023-06-01','2023-07-01') AND client = 'desktop' AND is_root_page QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY date ORDER BY SHA256(root_page), wptid) <= 20

SELECT date, page, root_page, wptid, TO_JSON_STRING(payload) AS original_payload, TO_JSON_STRING(metadata) AS source_metadata FROM `httparchive.crawl.pages` WHERE date = '2019-12-01' AND client = 'desktop' AND is_root_page AND wptid IN ('191220_DxD_TCW','191209_Dx4C_8JYQ') ORDER BY wptid

SELECT date, client, page, root_page, wptid, technologies,
JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.result') AS result,
JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.date') AS actual_test_epoch,
JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.lib-detector-version') AS library_detector_version,
TO_JSON_STRING(metadata) AS source_metadata
FROM `httparchive.crawl.pages`
WHERE date = '2019-12-01' AND client = 'desktop' AND is_root_page
ORDER BY SHA256(root_page), wptid LIMIT 20

SELECT date, wptid, TO_JSON_STRING(summary) AS source_summary FROM `httparchive.crawl.pages` WHERE date = '2019-12-01' AND client = 'desktop' AND is_root_page AND wptid IN ('191220_DxD_TCW','191209_Dx4C_8JYQ') ORDER BY wptid
